sourceFix.reason: Explicit per-group pin before thread-start made the same 120000 sleeper interrupts slower, 8.655s versus 6.534s, with verified placement. Queuing non-running targets onto the requesting processor is the same locality bet and was not applied.

diagnostic.placement: colocated groups 0..5 stayed on their pin for 20011 samples each

sample.observation: all 11 processors were inside sync-op GC, including mark_captured_continuation and barrier cond wait. One window, not the whole run.

negativeFailures: colocation diagnostic is slower and is not a pass
first startup-boot-gc BOOT-GC 2. exit 70 remains a distinct earlier failure
focused test2 inactive-thread-exception after normal termination remains
remainingCausalBlockers: p1 versus p11 wall gap remains after rejecting per-group co-location
real minus user minus system is only a lower bound and was not identified as device_select

sourceDefect.internalWake: device_select sees self-pipe ready, drains it, returns ERRNO(EINTR) when aborted and otherwise NO_ERR.
sourceDefect.retryConflation: os_condvar_select retries scheduler_select_eintr until fixed deff, absent immediate or actual IO readiness; internal scheduler wake is retried with unrelated OS signals.
sourceDefect.reasonIntegrity: FD_ISSET after EINTR is insufficient evidence; a separate reason must be based on actual positive pipe read or real platform abort event.
sourceDefect.implementationRequired: Private per-call reason, preserve public ABI/errno, prompt internal wake return after IO flags, genuine EINTR same-deadline retry.
sourceDefect.status: Actual matching-source defect; dominant original-stress cost attribution still requires native before/after and original acceptance.
